title: Web build fails intermittently in CI with a webpack TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 1)
description: Seen on PR 475 and PR 478 first runs, both PRs without web changes; passes on rerun. Find the cause (a webpack plugin or loader reading a null regex match) and fix it, or pin it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Third occurrence (PR 479). The log says: An error occurred in next/font, TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 1). Likely the build fetching Google Fonts over the network; consider bundling the fonts locally (next/font/local).

right_now_summary: The CI build intermittently fails when next/font fetches Google Fonts over the network.
